(BY SHRI DINESH PRASAD PATEL -DEPUTY G.A FOR STATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:

ORDER This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.14/2023, registered at Police Station-Mahila Thana,
District Katni (MP) for the offence under Sections 376(2)(N) of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely been implicated and was having law affairs with the prosecutrix.
Her consent was not obtained on the basis of false promise to marry.
In view of same, applicant be granted benefit of anticipatory bail.
3. Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and submitted that rape was done by applicant by giving false promise.

First incident had occurred on Dharmendra Dongre vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189295788/
1 10.09.2022 and report has been lodged on 14.04.2023 after delay of about 6 months.

sentences.text:
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Considering aforesaid, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the police in the aforesaid FIR, applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting officer (Investigating Officer)/trial Court for his regular appearance before the Police during the investigation or before the Court during trial.

7. It is directed that applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
